shortDescription: Create, modify, or delete OMEVV firmware repository profile

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: catalog_path
options.description: Absolute path of the catalog. HTTP, HTTPS, NFS, and CIFS paths are supported. This parameter is required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: description
options.description: Description of OMEVV firmware repository profile.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of the OpenManage Enterprise Modular.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the OMEVV firmware repository profile. This parameter is required for modification operation when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: new_name
options.description: Name of the new OMEVV profile name when modify operation is performed.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If I(resync) is true, then I(password) is required.

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise HTTPS port.

options.name: protocol_type
options.description: C(NFS) represents the NFS share path. C(CIFS) represents the NFS share path. C(HTTP) represents the HTTP share path. C(HTTPS) represents the HTTPS share path. This parameter is required when I(state) is C(present) and a new profile is created.

options.name: resync
options.description: Sync the repository profile from the UMP plugin.

options.name: share_domain
options.description: Domain of the share.

options.name: share_password
options.description: Password of the share. This parameter is required when I(catalog_path) is HTTPS or CIFS.

options.name: share_username
options.description: Username of the share. This parameter is required when I(catalog_path) is HTTPS or CIFS.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates an OMEVV firmware repository profile or modifies an existing profile if the profile with the same name exists. C(absent) deletes the OMEVV firmware repository profile. Either I(profile_name) or I(profile_id) is required when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If I(resync) is true, then I(username) is required.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to check SSL certificate. - If C(true), the SSL certificates will be validated. - If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated.

options.name: vcenter_password
options.description: Password for OpenManage Enterprise Integration for VMware vCenter (OMEVV). If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_PASSWORD=password

options.name: vcenter_username
options.description: Username for OpenManage Enterprise Integration for VMware vCenter (OMEVV). If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_USERNAME=username

options.name: vcenter_uuid
options.description: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of vCenter. vCenter UUID details can be retrieved using M(dellemc.openmanage.omevv_vcenter_info) module. If UUID is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_UUID) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_UUID=uuid
